reasoning_content: .env is already configured. Next, start the build in the background. Since docker compose up -d --build might take a long time (npm ci + next build), we'll run it in the background via nohup and poll it.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup docker compose up -d --build > /tmp/compose-up.log 2>&1 &
echo "started bg pid $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
